title: Issue #3921 execution
intent: Draft PR #4211 open with full CI green; Ready decision handed to PM (no verify record obtainable, #4205)
progress_summary: Root cause found and fixed: recv_issue_monitor_status_matching treated broadcast RecvError::Lagged as 'state unreachable'. The worker republishes its projection every 50ms into a 64-frame channel while the control barrier is up, so any test pausing ~3.2s between drains was lapped and failed instantly rather than at its deadline - which is why widening deadlines never fixed this family. Fixed the helper, added a deterministic regression test (RED proven by reverting only the lag handling), completed the AC-3 sweep onto the shared HANG_GUARD, and widened the two daemon_publisher busy-control budgets. Verified in a rust:1-bookworm container since these tests are cfg(all(test, unix)): target test 20/20, family 10/10 under load, full derived matrix green (lib 3097/3097, bin 951/951 with --init). PR #4211 is Draft with every CI check SUCCESS including the Linux Test (Rust) job. No verify.run record: the lease is held by the #4205 index loop renewing a 2h TTL.
